notes.title: Patch 1.02.00 - Released
notes.content:
Hello adventurers,

Patch 1.02.00 has introduced several additions and refinements to the game, including all outstanding issues reported on the official forums ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1154450/discussions/1/?snr=1_5_9_]HERE[/url])

[h3]Stability:[/h3]
1) The elevator may descend beyond the stopping point, rapidly fall, or cause the player to bounce in the air and out of bounds.
[list]
[*] Unexpected objects can change the calculations that govern the speed and travel distance of the elevator. In particular, the location of the player's virtual hands was a major contributor to many of the reported problems. The elevator now comes to a stop if it detects any abnormal behavior and will gracefully resume normal operations once the player has adjusted their position.[/list]
[h3]Visual changes:[/h3]
2) Minor adjustments were made to lighting throughout the game. 
3) A new effect was added to the camera in The Restored City.

[h3]Audio changes:[/h3]
4) An additional soundtrack was added to The Abyss
5) Additional musical elements were added to 'The Balancing Rock Puzzle' in The Abyss.
6) New sound effects were added throughout the game.

[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
7) Some players may be unable to release a ladder by returning it to its drop zone.
[list]
[*] This issue was triggered by climbing too quickly or attempting to move the ladder while climbing. A check was added to the code that prevents this behavior.[/list]
8) Indicators were added to assist players seeking out important items.
9) A check was added at the end of The Abyss to verify the player did not leave behind important items. 
10) Corrected a rare bug that prevented players from teleporting following their death.

[h3]Puzzles:[/h3]
11) The addition of subtle indicators should reduce the difficulty of mid game puzzles and basic navigation. All new indicators can be found following The Restored City.
12) The randomization of all spark generators was decreased. 
13) An invisible wall was added in The Restored City to prevent discarding key items.
14) Adjustments were made to 'The Stacking Box Puzzle' in The Restored City.
15) Adjustments were made to prevent players from bypassing blocked passageways in The Abyss.
16) Adjustments were made to the position of player constructed bridges in The Abyss.
17) Adjustments were made to 'The Roast Puzzle' following The Abyss.

notes.title: v1.01.855 Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello adventurers,

We made more updates to improve the overall game experience.

• Added additional collision elements to the control platform for the elevator.
• Fixed a game crash when certain pottery elements are broken.
• Some ledges were modified to reduce the likelihood of falling. 

Please keep feedback coming in the official forums!

Best Regards,
NotARobot042
